description: Renew an expired or missing Derive session in one local, owner-signed workflow while preserving the existing subaccount and funds.

expiry_days.description: Renewed session lifetime in days. Defaults to 30.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable workflow key. Reuse it after interruption.

max_deposit_usd.description: Owner-authorized Derive allowance; defaults to the $1B protocol range.

name: repair_derive_session
